description: The app's server key, for running room.js on the developer's own server (serverMode "own", see neblla_get_llms({ section: "servidor" }) "Server"). Their server runs `npx @neblla/server --app <appId> --key $NEBLLA_SERVER_KEY ./server`: it calls Neblla, no open ports or public URL. action "create" makes the key (refused if one exists), "rotate" replaces it (the old one stops at once), "status" says whether one exists, "revoke" removes it. The key is returned ONLY by create and rotate: it goes in the server's environment, never in the app.
name: neblla_server_key
